subject: MAP Kickoff: aligning evaluation sprint windows & close sprint
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: aligning evaluation sprint windows & close sprint

Hi Elena / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation I wanted to get a short kickoff note in writing so we have a shared cadence and clear owners for the evaluation and close phases. Goals for this MAP:

- Get a representative integration + 1k inference-hour eval on Redwood hosted by 2026-10-08.
- Prove p95 latency <= 250ms for your main workflows and validate cost per 1k tokens with our Optimize recommendations.
- Complete security checklist and procurement sign-off to start reserved capacity purchase by 2026-10-15.

Proposed cadence (weekly checkpoints):
- Weekly 30-min syncs, Mondays at 10:00am PT starting 2026-09-14.
- Ad-hoc engineering deep-dive sessions as needed (owner: Ben).

Initial owners:
- Redwood MAP lead: jasmine_liu — overall coordination, exec updates.
- Integration & perf: ben_carter — test harness, perf runs, dashboard.
- Security & compliance evidence: neha_kapoor — SOC2 artifacts, retention policy, KMS notes.
- Commercial & SLA: markus_klein — pricing, reserved capacity options, SLA exceptions.

Attached: initial MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.2.xlsx) with a draft timeline and HelioHealth-specific success criteria. Please review the success criteria section before our first sync and flag anything that would block sign-off.

Next steps before Monday:
1) Elena/Raj: confirm stakeholders who should be on the weekly syncs (ops, infra, procurement).
2) Ben: publish the perf test plan to the shared Drive.
3) Neha: attach the minimal evidence list we need for procurement (SOC2 report, data flow diagram).

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: aligning evaluation sprint windows & close sprint

Thanks Jasmine — quick notes from engineering side:

- I'll take the perf/integration owner role and drop a test plan in the Drive by EOD Friday (2026-09-17). Link will include sample prompt sets and dataset slice definitions.
- I propose two perf windows: a short smoke (1 run, small dataset) the week of 9/21 and the full 1k-hour run 9/28–10/05. That should give Helio the metrics to validate p95 and token cost.
- For the smoke we only need a light VM + Redwood hosted instance — no reserved capacity. For the full run we'll coordinate reserved capacity testing (Markus to confirm capacity window availability).

Action items I’m owning:
- Publish perf plan and test harness to Drive (ben_carter).
- Prepare a short runbook for how Helio triggers the smoke runs (SLA for support: 2 business hours during run).

Elena — are there any production-like datasets you want included in the smoke? If yes, we need a sanitized sample by 9/18.

Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: aligning evaluation sprint windows & close sprint

Thanks all — this plan looks reasonable. A few notes from HelioHealth:

- Stakeholders: please add Sarah Connors (ops@heliohealth.com) and Victor Huang (security@heliohealth.com) to the weekly invite. Procurement will be copied in once we hit the evidence checklist milestone.
- Datasets: we can provide a sanitized 1k-record sample by 9/17. That works for the smoke. For the full run we need to confirm tokenization costs upfront (if there are special pre-processing steps that increase tokens).
- Security artifacts: Victor will want the SOC2 summary and a data flow diagram before the full run. Can Neha share the minimal evidence list you mentioned?

One ask: Helio's internal approval window for vendor spend is 7 business days after procurement has the artifact set. Can Redwood align the MAP timeline so procurement receives evidence by 10/05 so we can be in-contract by 10/15?

If we can meet that, Helio is prepared to commit to reserved capacity starting 10/18.

Elena
Director of Product, HelioHealth
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: aligning evaluation sprint windows & close sprint

Elena / team — attaching the minimal evidence set and a short checklist for procurement. I also uploaded the security checklist to the Drive (link in related_links).

Summary of what I shared:
- SOC2 summary + auditor contact (redacted link).
- Data flow diagram (redwood-dataflow-v1.pdf) and notes on where PII is filtered out.
- Retention policy excerpt and key management notes (KMS/HSM integration).

Updated timeline and owners (reflected in MAP_v1.2):
- 2026-09-17: Helio to provide sanitized dataset for smoke run (owner: Helio).
- 2026-09-21: Smoke run (owner: Ben).
- 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-05: Full 1k-hour evaluation run (owner: Ben).
- 2026-10-05: Security evidence delivered to Procurement (owner: Neha).
- 2026-10-15: Procurement sign-off window closes (Helio internal).
- 2026-10-18: Target reserved capacity start date.

Action items (short):
- Helio: confirm additional attendees for weekly syncs (Elena).
- Helio: deliver sanitized sample dataset by 9/17 (Raj).
- Ben: publish perf plan by 9/17 (Ben).
- Neha: upload evidence and notify procurement by 10/05 (Neha).

Attachments: security-checklist.pdf, HelioHealth-Eval-Criteria.docx

I’ll send a calendar invite for the Monday 10:00am PT recurring meeting after Elena confirms attendees.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-checklist.pdf (pdf)]
